snippet.title: Inferno Protocol - Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
The rules are simple: survive and find the exit.
Memory is your map.
The marks are your guide.

Inferno Protocol is a 6-player co-op survival horror action experience, coming Q1 2026.
Step into the multi-versal maze with your squad.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3908940/Inferno_Protocol

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Discover more about the game, upcoming updates, and our development journey:
🌐 Official Website: https://tektonicinteractive.com/

Be part of the community and join us on Discord:
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/3EhwzJg9ub
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
